calls.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished portrait reference page titled "Tutu" with EXACTLY 24 readable studies in FOUR rows of SIX, ivory background, concise cell labels. Subject: Female SQUIRREL friend, proposed current book adaptation: warm russet fur, cream muzzle/chest/belly, short rounded muzzle and small dark nose, brown readable irises, tufted ears, large fluffy upward-curving tail. No quills, no clothes or bow. Original text establishes squirrel/nut basket; original group scene does not identify a unique portrait. Do not copy hedgehog anatomy. Input roles: first 1 image(s) subject SOURCE evidence; next image PinPin 24-study is LAYOUT/DIRECTION ONLY, never species/anatomy/clothing; last family image is warm dimensional BOOK STYLE only. Keep target species in EVERY cell. Match the template grid and opposing left/right poses, NOT its hedgehog appearance. Row1 FACE VIEWS in order: Front: nose/beak centered toward viewer. Left 3/4: nose/beak points to SCREEN LEFT, both eyes visible. Left profile: true side, nose/beak points SCREEN LEFT. Right 3/4: nose/beak points SCREEN RIGHT, both eyes visible. Right profile: true side, nose/beak points SCREEN RIGHT. Rear: back, face invisible. Row2 Expressions: Calm, Curious, Happy, Surprised, Sleepy, Mild upset; natural variation no constant grin. Row3 WHOLE BODY VIEWS in order: Front: nose/beak centered toward viewer. Left 3/4: nose/beak points to SCREEN LEFT, both eyes visible. Left profile: true side, nose/beak points SCREEN LEFT. Right 3/4: nose/beak points SCREEN RIGHT, both eyes visible. Right profile: true side, nose/beak points SCREEN RIGHT. Rear: back, face invisible. Body must rotate as a whole, including torso and tail; LEFT three-quarter and LEFT profile must face LEFT; RIGHT three-quarter and RIGHT profile must face RIGHT, not duplicate left-facing bodies under right labels. Row4 Normal poses: Sit, Wave, Hold nut, Carry basket, Reach, Rest. All full bodies framed with margin, same size within each row, clear separate appropriate limbs, no crops or fused anatomy. Preserve target identity and materials. No extra characters, no numeric age or measured height. Label subtitle "Proposed book adaptation".

calls.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE separate portrait CAST INTERACTION reference page titled "Tutu — Cast interactions" with SIX large readable panels in THREE rows of TWO, ivory backdrop, short labels, full bodies and generous margins. FIRST IMAGE is PRIMARY TARGET IDENTITY: current verified target solo sheet. Lock its species, face, body, materials, limbs and clothing in EVERY panel. Other images are target source, actual counterpart identity and published book style; never substitute hedgehogs for target. Target/source basis: Original chapter9 establishes female squirrel friend with nut basket. Original chapter4 group image supplies squirrel silhouettes but no identified Tutu portrait. Russet fur, cream belly, tufted ears and fluffy curved tail are proposed current adaptation details. Explicit participant assignments: Female squirrel friend Tutu; PinPin child hedgehog, Rabbit/Lulu rabbit peer. Family reference: Mama is copper-quilled adult LEFT, Papa broad cooler-quilled adult CENTER, PinPin older child RIGHT, infant excluded. Maintain natural book dimensional rendering, engaged shared gaze, consistent relative size across panels, clear owned paws/wings, grounded feet and support/contact, no merged bodies, extra limbs or cropped tails. PANELS: 1 Shared ground peer scale: female russet SQUIRREL TUTU, child golden-quilled HEDGEHOG PINPIN, gray/tan long-eared RABBIT LULU stand on same plane. Squirrel body roughly child companion scale; proposed relative size, no measurements. 2 Nut exchange: SQUIRREL TUTU passes acorn to child HEDGEHOG PINPIN paw-to-paw; separate limbs, fluffy squirrel tail not quills. 3 Gentle hug: SQUIRREL TUTU and child HEDGEHOG PINPIN hug with clear separate whole bodies and owned paws. 4 Carry basket together: SQUIRREL TUTU and RABBIT LULU hold opposite handles of one small nut basket on ground, rabbit long ears not squirrel ears. 5 Quiet story: SQUIRREL TUTU sits on low stump telling story to seated HEDGEHOG PINPIN and RABBIT LULU, attentive gazes. 6 Gather nuts: SQUIRREL TUTU and HEDGEHOG PINPIN crouch and place separate acorns into one stable basket, whole tails/quills/feet visible. Labels describe actual shared actions. No solo portrait row or decorative unrelated characters. Subtitle "Proposed book adaptation"; do not pretend new colors/scale are original measured facts.
